name: AppShell
description: The application frame: a sidebar and a main column (an optional top bar, then the content) as islands separated by a gutter. The sidebar holds a brand, the navigation (a Menu) and a footer, and can collapse to icons. Replaces Livewire's main and the React and Vue Sidebar.

livewire.name: app-shell
capabilities: Slots: brand, sidebar, header and footer; the default slot is the content
wire:model binds collapsed; without it, the collapsed state is kept in the session (the 2.x toggle route)

vue.name: AppShell
capabilities: Slots: brand, sidebar, header and footer; the default slot is the content

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Shrinks the sidebar to its icons: a Menu inside shows icon-only items, their labels kept for screen readers. Emitted as data-collapsed. Livewire binds it with wire:model.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Adds the button at the foot of the sidebar that collapses and expands it. Emitted as data-collapsible.

props.name: sidebarWidth
props.description: The expanded sidebar's width, any CSS length. Sets --apui-sidebar-width on the root (default 248px).

props.name: gutter
props.description: The space around and between the islands, any CSS length. Sets --apui-shell-gutter on the root (default 12px).

props.name: brand
props.description: The brand at the top of the sidebar: a logo or mark and the product name, usually a link home.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: The sidebar's navigation, usually a Menu: 5 to 8 top-level items, the rest under section titles.

props.name: header
props.description: The bar at the top of the main column, usually a Navbar with layout island.

props.name: footer
props.description: The foot of the sidebar: the signed-in account and its actions.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the sidebar's complementary landmark. Livewire translates the default with __().

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: The skip link's text. Livewire translates the default with __().

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Names the collapse button, which is aria-pressed while the sidebar is collapsed. Livewire translates the default with __().

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { sidebar: '…', content: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The frame: a grid of the sidebar and the main column on the page surface.

parts.name: skipLink
parts.description: The first focusable element: a link to the main column, hidden until focused.

parts.name: sidebar
parts.description: The sidebar island, a complementary landmark named with label. It moves to the inline end in RTL.

parts.name: brand
parts.description: The brand at the top of the sidebar.

parts.name: footer
parts.description: The foot of the sidebar, separated by an edge: the account, and the collapse button.

parts.name: collapseTrigger
parts.description: Collapses and expands the sidebar: aria-pressed while collapsed, named with collapseLabel. Its icon mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: main
parts.description: The main landmark, the skip link's target: the header, then the content.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The page's content under the header: a column of panels with the panel gap.

slots.name: brand
slots.description: The brand at the top of the sidebar.

slots.name: header
slots.description: The top bar of the main column.

events.name: collapsed-change
events.description: The collapse button collapsed or expanded the sidebar. Setting collapsed doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: The skip link comes first and shows while focused; Enter on it moves focus to the main landmark.
On the collapse button: collapses or expands the sidebar.

requirements: The sidebar is an aside (complementary landmark) named with label; the content is a main landmark.
A skip link to the main landmark is the first focusable element.
The current navigation item uses aria-current=page (Menu).
Collapsed, the sidebar's Menu items show only their icons; their labels stay in the accessibility tree.
The collapse button is aria-pressed while collapsed, and named with collapseLabel.
Layout uses logical properties, so the sidebar sits at the inline end in RTL; on a narrow viewport the islands stack.
Keep 5 to 8 top-level items; group the rest under section titles.
